_meta.ciphersuite: BLS12-381 min-pubkey (pk G1, sig G2), POP scheme

registerAtNonce1.rule: same key at nonce 1: v1 rotation fixture; v2 registries revert KeyPreviouslyUsed (use `slots` for rotation)
same key at nonce 1: v1 rotation fixture; v2 registries revert KeyPreviouslyUsed (use `slots` for rotation)
same key at nonce 1: v1 rotation fixture; v2 registries revert KeyPreviouslyUsed (use `slots` for rotation)

rePaired.rule: a valid aggregate under a maker key other than auth.makerKeyCommitment must fail

popWrongDst.rule: PoP signed under DST_SIG must fail PoP verification

popWrongDstSepolia.rule: PoP signed under DST_SIG must fail PoP verification

popStaleNonce.rule: PoP bound to nonce 0 must revert once the stored nonce is 1

tamperedRoot.rule: aggSig over the real auth must fail against a tampered adChainRoot

singleSigNotAggregate.rule: one party's sig alone must fail the aggregate pairing check

malformedAggSig.rule: bytes that decode to no curve point must revert

_meta.walletSig: EVM primary = personal_sign over the message string (65B r||s||v); Stellar primary = SEP-53 ed25519 over sha256(prefix || message) (64B)

bridger.message0: ProofBridge BLS key derivation v1 — do not sign on other dapps | key #0000
bridger.message1: ProofBridge BLS key derivation v1 — do not sign on other dapps | key #0001

maker.message0: ProofBridge BLS key derivation v1 — do not sign on other dapps | key #0000
maker.message1: ProofBridge BLS key derivation v1 — do not sign on other dapps | key #0001

deadline.rule: RegisterKey only: refused when chain time > deadline, or deadline > chain time + maxTtl; clients default to defaultTtl

typeStrings.registerKey: RegisterKey(bytes32 account,bytes32 keyCommitment,KeyLeg[] legs,uint64 deadline)KeyLeg(uint256 chainId,bytes32 registry,uint256 nonce)
typeStrings.revokeKeys: RevokeKeys(bytes32 account,KeyLeg[] legs)KeyLeg(uint256 chainId,bytes32 registry,uint256 nonce)

_meta.text: lines joined by \n, no trailing newline; SEP-53 payload = sha256("Stellar Signed Message:\n" || text)
_meta.layout: register[i]: slots key i at nonce i on both legs (one signature, both registries), deadline _meta.deadline.register; registerLate[i]: the same with deadline _meta.deadline.registerLate; revoke[n]: both legs at nonce n; retire[i*2 + (validUntil==1 ? 0 : 1)]: key i, validUntil 1 or slots.graceTs
_meta.sigs: secp256k1: sig = r||s||v (65 B) on both registries. sep53: sig = the bare 64 B (Soroban), evmSig = abi.encode(r, s, edX, edY) (EVM)

secpForms.rule: bridger register[0] (entry fields = ownerAuth.bridger.register[0]) with only `sig` changed; `expect` is every verifier's answer (refuse = OwnerMismatch)

secpOnNonEvmAccount.rule: a secp256k1 signature for an account that is not 12 zero bytes ‖ address must be refused (OwnerMismatch)

sep53OnEvmAccount.rule: an ed25519 signature for an EVM-shaped account must be refused (OwnerMismatch); PoPs = slots.bridgerOn*.registrations[0]

tamperedText.rule: the maker's signature over `signedText` (one byte off the text the registries rebuild for register[0]) must be refused

_meta.evm: eth_signTypedData_v4, domain (ProofBridge Keys, 2) with no salt, SettlementIdentity(string statement,uint32 index), statement "ProofBridge Settlement Identity"
_meta.stellar: SEP-53 signMessage over settlementIdentityText(N) = statement + \n\n + Index: N
_meta.kdf: ikm = r || low-s (secp256k1, v dropped) or the 64-byte ed25519 sig; okm = HKDF-SHA256(ikm, salt = empty, info = "ProofBridge.SettlementIdentity.v1", 48); sk = (okm mod (n-1)) + 1

highSVariant.rule: high-s, v in 0/1 form: derives bridger[0]'s M

eip2098.rule: the bridger's identity signature for `index` in EIP-2098 form: derives `secretKey`, the same M as the 65-byte form
